title: SKU coverage gap analysis and rapid-order playbook
content:
Purpose:
This is a tactical working doc: identify immediate SKU coverage gaps across regions, align on a rapid-order playbook (what to order now vs wait), and capture lead-time assumptions + fallback lanes. Not an exec brief — actionable checklist for procurement + infra ops for next 8–20 weeks.

TL;DR (one-paragraph):
- We have a shortfall in H100-class capacity in us-west and eu-west for burst workloads over the next 12 weeks. A mixed approach: prioritize targeted short shipments of L40S (low-lead, medium throughput) for low-cost inference, while simultaneously placing staggered H100 tranche orders (primary vendor + secondary broker) to restore peak throughput by week 16. Reorder-points adjusted to 60% utilization for critical clusters until arrivals clear.

Scope and audience:
- Audience: procurement ops, infra SRE, serving-runtime leads, finance on-call
- Scope: physical GPU orders, transport lead times, customs/ETAs, regional coverage (us-west, us-east, eu-west, ap-south). Excludes cloud-burst credits.

Key assumptions (explicit):
- Current baseline demand forecast uses rolling 4-week 95th percentile request curve (source: console/usage/forecast-2026-02).
- Target steady-state utilization: 55% token-processing util (buffers for autoscale spikes). Reorder trigger = projected >70% in any region for 3 consecutive days.
- Vendors: Primary (Vendor A, direct OEM), Secondary (Broker B), Tertiary (Cloud partner spot/market).
- Typical vendor lead-times (best-estimate): H100 family: 12–20 weeks; A100 family: 6–12 weeks; L40/L40S: 4–8 weeks. Logistics variance +/- 2 weeks.

Current inventory snapshot (as of 2026-02-22):
- Total GPUs (fleet): 9,620 units
  - H100-80GB: 1,450
  - A100-80GB: 2,200
  - A100-40GB: 1,200
  - L40S-48GB: 2,600
  - T4 (edge/test): 1,170

On-order pipeline (committed PO / ETA):
- PO-4892 (Vendor A): 320 H100-80GB — ETA week 14 (expected arrival window 2026-05-04 to 2026-05-18)
- PO-4910 (Broker B): 180 A100-80GB — ETA week 6 (arriving in batches)
- PO-4931 (Vendor A): 600 L40S — ETA week 8 (staged deliveries by region)

Regional coverage notes (current concentration + gap):
- us-west: high demand (SLO-attached models). Current H100 count: 640. Projected shortfall by week 8 if utilization remains >65%: ~220 H100-equivalent capacity needed.
- us-east: balanced. A100-heavy fleet. Regional reorder not urgent; monitor spot/credits for bursts.
- eu-west: medium demand growth for embeddings; H100s limited (210 units). Shortfall risk weeks 6–12 for low-latency clients.
- ap-south: emerging infra, L40-heavy, safe for next 10 weeks; prioritize smaller replenishments.

Lead-time buckets and recommended tactic (fast -> slow):
- Fast lane (4–8 weeks): place add-on L40S and A100-40 orders via Vendor A expedited inventory; use this lane for immediate soft capacity (shards for non-critical models).
- Mid lane (8–12 weeks): A100-80 and larger L40 bulk orders. Good for planned growth and replacing end-of-life units.
- Slow lane (12–20+ weeks): H100 family primary tranches. Place staggered POs now (week 0, week 4) to smooth arrivals.

Rapid-order playbook (checklist):
- Trigger check: region utilization > 60% for 3d OR predicted surge (>20% delta) in forecast -> run this playbook.
- Step 1: Re-evaluate placement groups (can we shift non-SLO workloads to other regions for 7–14 days?). Owner: Noah (infra-sre).
- Step 2: Execute fast-lane MRP: place expedited PO for L40S in region(s) with immediate gaps (min order qty 50 units) to relieve queue. Owner: Procurement (Ethan). Slack alert to #infra-procurement.
- Step 3: Open staggered H100 PO with Vendor A + place mirrored broker order (Broker B) with different ETAs as hedge. Finance to pre-approve tranche 1 (owner: Maya).
- Step 4: Reserve cross-region transfer capacity: mark up to 10% of L40S fleet as transferable for emergency bursts. Owner: logistics leads.
- Step 5: Configure temporary autoscale and model throttles: pin risky routes to A100 / L40 tiers and throttle non-critical batch jobs. Owner: serving-runtime.
- Step 6: Notify CS + account teams for customers in impacted regions (clear timeline + mitigation). Owner: solutions-eng.
- Step 7: Update runbook and ops dashboard with new POs and ETAs. Owner: Asha.

Order sizing heuristics (short guidance):
- Fast-lane orders: 50–200 units per region (pref small, frequent shipments to avoid customs bottlenecks).
- Slow-lane H100 tranches: 200–400 units per tranche per vendor depending on budget window. Stagger by 4 weeks.
- Safety buffer: maintain a 6-week equivalent buffer for critical regions (us-west, eu-west).

Fallback lanes and contingencies (if lead-time slips):
- If H100 tranche slips >4 weeks: convert a portion of orders to A100-80/reserve cloud GPUs (pre-negotiated credit line).
- If customs delay in EU: divert shipments to NL port + regional truck; estimated +1–2 weeks but maintains pipeline flow.
- Emergency rental: short-term rental racks via Partner C (costly) — last resort.

Risks & unresolved questions (notes to self):
- Broker pricing volatility: Broker B quoted 12% premium vs OEM last month — need updated quote before commit.
- Are we comfortable with L40-heavy short-term mitigation for latency-sensitive SLOs? (serving-runtime to validate degradation envelope).
- Customs classification update scheduled Q2 — could shift import windows. Confirm with legal.

Cost sensitivity and finance notes:
- Rough cost delta (expected): H100 ~ 3.6x A100 unit cost, L40 ~ 0.65x A100 (ballpark). Budgeting: stagger payments across quarters to smooth cashflow.
- Currency FX: EU orders priced in EUR have lower volatility vs broker USD quotes — consider hedging for big tranches.

Decision log (recent calls):
- 2026-02-09: Decided to prioritize H100 tranche order cadence of 320 units (PO-4892) — signed by Procurement lead.
- 2026-02-15: Approved expedited L40S 600-unit PO split across 3 regions — pending logistics routing confirmation.

Immediate next steps (action items):
- [Ethan] Get updated broker quote from Broker B by 2026-02-27.
- [Noah] Validate safe-shift checklist for moving non-critical workloads by 2026-02-25.
- [Maya] Approve tranche 2 finance allocation for H100 on receipt of updated quote (due 2026-03-03).
- [Asha] Post final runbook updates and tag POs in dashboard by 2026-02-24.

Appendix A — Quick order template (copy/paste to PO):
- SKU / Part #: {SKU}
appendix_template:
- Qty: {qty}
- Delivery window: earliest possible / latest acceptable
- Delivery region: {region}
- Incoterms: DDP preferred
- Vendor lead-time guarantee: X weeks (penalty terms)
- Packing / palletization notes: we need regional pallet counts
- Customs HS code: 8471.70 (confirm with customs)
